marc:datafield.marc:subfield: With Chicago on the verge of an all-out civil war, TRIS (Shailene Woodley) leads FOUR (Theo James), CHRISTINA (Zoe Kravitz), PETER (MIles Teller), TORI (Maggie Q) and CALEB (Ansel Elgort) on a harrowing escape from the walled city, chased by armed guards loyal to self appointed leader EVELYN (Naomi Watts). Outside Chicago for the first time in their lives, the five find themselves being pursued by EDGAR (Johny Weston) through a toxic wasteland known as the Fringe before being rescued and escorted to the ultra-high-tech compound of the Bureau of Genetic Welfare...
